question: In Ayamatsu, did Ana know that it was Subaru that killed Julius?
answer: Subaru Natsuki had to be killed in the end by Emilia, so it would be unacceptable to be gaining anyone's attention before that. If there was any small chance of him being killed and another candidate becoming the queen, then it was all for nothing. Hence, he thoroughly removed all traces of himself, so there was no reason for it to come to light.
